verdict.rationale: Basecamp publishes its own REST API reference and an OpenAPI spec covering every endpoint, with "Copy as cURL" examples throughout. Those examples are runnable once copied into a terminal. Nothing shows an interactive in-browser explorer or try-it console. missing for 10: interactive explorer/try-it console in the reference, in-browser runnable examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
Throughout the Basecamp API docs, we include "Copy as cURL" examples.
